meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Builds distinctive, production-grade UIs that avoid generic AI aesthetics. Use whenever the user wants to build, restyle, or give visual direction to any interface — pages, dashboards, landing pages, components, onboarding flows, mobile screens, or design systems — even without an explicit 'design' request. Also triggers for: picking an aesthetic direction, improving the look of a dull/generic existing page, adding visual personality, or choosing colors/typography. Includes a bundled design intelligence database for concrete guidance across web (React, Next.js, Vue, Tailwind) and mobile (React Native, Flutter, SwiftUI).
